description: Denver Metropolitan Pedestrian Networks is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Garrett Fardon, Manish Shirgaokar. A series of pedestrian networks in the Denver metropolitan area All files are uploaded in a zip archive file format- they will need to be extracted before opening in ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar programs. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
